semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Raydent Industrial provides specialized surface treatment technologies that enhance the performance of metal components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Raydent Industrial specializes in advanced surface treatment technologies for metal parts, particularly within the semiconductor value chain. Their unique process enhances the performance and durability of metal components, making them a key supplier for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and materials used in assembly and processing.
capabilities: Advanced surface treatment for metal components
Polymer resin incorporation for enhanced durability

regional_presence.Japan: Founded in Kyoto, Raydent Industrial has a strong presence in Japan, focusing on advanced surface treatment technologies for the semiconductor industry.
